rows.req: Price-snapshot store records an opening and a closing number for every market we originate
rows.evidence: 78 markets x open + close, 1 hash-chained snapshot file, 0 with an official market price (none exists)

rows.req: Verified results feed, so backtests and ROI can be computed at all
rows.evidence: 137 finals from official week pages, reconciled against official standings on all 32 clubs

rows.req: Originate the side first, then the total, then the moneyline
rows.evidence: fixed code path in scripts/ops_model.py; moneyline is Phi(side/sigma) so it cannot contradict the side

rows.req: Publish the model's fair line, the market line and the difference as separate columns
rows.evidence: fair and difference columns present; market column null with reason NO_OFFICIAL_SOURCE on every row

rows.req: Separate signal from staking so a lucky staking run cannot mask a bad signal
rows.evidence: two independent columns, promotion reads signal only; 5 strategies in paper, 0 live

rows.req: Track the depth of the replacement, not just the fact of a replacement
rows.evidence: 45 absences resolved with a depth string, 8 published as having nobody below them, 22 not joinable

rows.req: Compute correlations only from officially sourced numbers and publish n with each value
rows.evidence: 9 coefficients, each with n, 95% CI and p, all from official pages

rows.req: Define a demotion gate that sends a live strategy back to paper
rows.evidence: 6 demotion gates defined; D-1 dry-run gate fires at bet 146

rows.req: Clean dashboard landing page with category subpages, all entries in tables
rows.evidence: 18 pages, one navigation, every data page in table form

rows.req: A suggestions section someone can review and choose a path from before anything is implemented
rows.evidence: proposal register with status, effort, impact, risk and the decision each needs

rows.req: A clear list of questions, information and answers that must be settled before a decision
rows.evidence: each row carries what we have, what is missing, what it blocks and how to find it

rows.req: Single bets, parlays and player-prop bet combos can be originated
rows.evidence: 10 prop markets and 54 graded legs; parlays blocked on a measured joint probability (G-8) and on market prices (G-5)

rows.req: Every table row carries a source link to an official site, or is blank and flagged
rows.evidence: enforced by scripts/ops_verify.py on every build and in CI

rows.req: Injury and lineup deficiencies (2nd/3rd/4th string) are tracked for offence and defense
rows.evidence: tracked on both sides of the ball ({'offense': 25, 'secondary': 5, 'dline': 6, 'lb': 9}); no validated effect size, so not a model input

rows.req: Leaderboard competition with rewards for top-performing strategies
rows.evidence: competition, gates and demotion defined; reward rule undecided, nothing promised

rows.req: Executive summary outlining the important details
rows.evidence: one page: what the desk does, what the data says, what cannot be claimed, decisions needed

rows.req: No manual input: every artifact generated by a committed script
rows.evidence: six scripts regenerate the whole tree from official captures; the verification gate proves it

rows.req: Determine correlation values for combos and remove luck from the equation
rows.evidence: 9 correlations measured with CI; luck bounded by walk-forward, CI and demotion, but never removed - a single game stays mostly noise
